class: A scenario replay cannot be run twice: frames go forward only and each rule writes one alert per trade per day, so alert fixes cannot be seen again on screen until the stored test records are cleared. A fixture whose frames skip a candle close also makes an on-time alert look late.
mechanism: The fixture stores its last frame and the rules store their one alert per day; the fixture jumps from 14:31 to 15:25, and rules fire at the candle close (ADR-237).

first_seen.where: GC-ICFIX close-out proofs u607 and the re-proof, test-data copy PATH-61
first_seen.evidence: Re-proof: POST frame 1 returned last frame 9, no new record after 3 minutes (max id stayed 347), so four alert fixes (yes/no name, T-10b name, T-02 line, stored limit) were NOT REACHABLE on screen. u607: the clock rule wrote its record at frame 9 (15:25), not frame 8 (14:31); the 'late' alert was the fixture jumping over the candle close.

fix: None yet. Needs a fixture reset, a frame just after a candle close (14:36), and the morning's test alert rows cleared (owner word needed for deleting rows).
